properties.NOTES:
The sensor was lowered in and put out to measure the exact depth. 
The orientation was marked with tape and a marker to lower with a lot of attention on the twist of the cable. 
The preparation involved unwrapping 10m of cables to lay it flat and avoid any disturbance from it. 
We poured sand until the sensor was not moving in the borehole anymore (~2/3L)
The proximity to high voltage might make the station noisy to be determined once finished.
